scope: Redesign the remaining guarded Nano parallel SSD output/chunk-scan kernel for GPU-parallel execution while preserving token/logit correctness.
guard: New output redesign remains opt-in inside KRASIS_MAMBA2_SSD_PARALLEL_CHUNKED=1 and the existing startup diagnostic/block-scan/coeff-tile/candidate-timing gates.
acceptance_target: Token/logit parity against the accepted serial/control Krasis path; old serial internal-state bit identity remains diagnostic only for the parallel architecture.

implementation.design: Launch one CTA per (head, d-tile, chunk) instead of one CTA per (head, d-tile) serially walking chunks; preserve the 1408 per-chunk output arithmetic and keep the old guarded output kernel available when the env is unset.
implementation.shared_memory_fix: The by-chunk kernel uses the requested triangular-tile dynamic shared memory instead of requesting the device maximum opt-in size.

startup_failure_before_fix.reason: cuFuncSetAttribute(MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES=101376) returned CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE for the new by-chunk kernel

build3.reason: Rebuilt after replacing the literal shared-memory threshold with CUDA runtime device attributes

correctness.comparison: by-chunk vs accepted guarded parallel chunked control

vram_check.note: Startup calibration/diagnostic was not close to the safety margin; record for later production HCS/budget review.

status_note: Implemented, validated, and measured. Path remains guarded and not production-enabled.
